name: Yuuen no Hana Zoku Inbaku no Yakata
original_name: 優艶の花 続 淫縛の館
source: Yuuka, who left the house, was wandering around without a destination. The memory of pleasure deeply carved into the body ... The days of desperately trying to erase the lust that suddenly attacks. There was a magical hand aiming at her and attacking her !!
translation: 离开家的优香，漫无目的地四处游荡。快感的记忆深深地刻在了身体里……拼命抹去突然袭来的情欲的日子。有一只魔手瞄准了她，向她攻击！！
